proof_body:
by
  intro T _ f g
  have e : ∫ t, (starRingEnd ℂ) (f t) * g t ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle = inner ℂ f g := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
    congr 1
    funext t
    rw [RCLike.inner_apply, mul_comm]
  rw [e]
  refine HasSum.congr_fun ((fourierBasis (T := T)).hasSum_inner_mul_inner f g) (fun n => ?_)
  simp only [← fourierBasis_repr, HilbertBasis.repr_apply_apply, inner_conj_symm, mul_comm (inner ℂ f _)]
target_source: ∀ (T : ℝ) [hT : Fact (0 < T)] (f g : MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 (AddCircle.haarAddCircle (T := T))), HasSum (fun n : ℤ => (starRingEnd ℂ) (fourierCoeff f n) * fourierCoeff g n) (∫ t, (starRingEnd ℂ) (f t) * g t ∂AddCircle.haarAddCircle)
